name: RSITool
description: Relative Strength Index indicator - measures momentum by comparing recent gains vs losses. Values above 70 indicate overbought, below 30 indicate oversold.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: The dataRef string returned from a market data tool (YahooFinanceTool, PolygonTool, etc). You MUST first call a market data tool, wait for its response containing dataRef, then use that exact dataRef value here. Do NOT guess or invent this value.

fields.label: RSI Period
fields.description: Number of periods for RSI calculation. CHOOSE based on analysis timeframe and sensitivity needed: Day trading/short-term use 7-9 (more sensitive, quicker signals), swing trading use 14 (standard), long-term/position trading use 21-28 (smoother, fewer false signals). For volatile stocks, use longer periods to reduce noise.
